problem_context.expected_behavior: Given a non-null data node, return exactly its node_next pointer; preserve the node field and the entire suffix chain. The result may be NULL when the node is the tail.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require the supplied node to own a complete xizi_sll chain whose abstract sequence is the node itself followed by suffix l. Ensure there exists the stored next pointer equal to the return value, with node_next ownership and xizi_sll(next,l) preserved.
spec_hint: This is a data-node API, not a sentinel-head API. Prefer public xizi_sll(linklist_node, cons(linklist_node,l)) in Require, then unfold once in Ensure to expose the returned next pointer. When l=nil, xizi_sll(next,nil) forces next=NULL.
preferred_hidden_properties: xizi_sll(linklist_node, cons(linklist_node,l)) unfolds to exists next, linklist_node->node_next=next * xizi_sll(next,l).
forbidden_patterns: Do not use xizi_sll_head; do not require the suffix to be nonempty; do not exclude tail nodes; do not mirror the getter as a Rocq algorithm.
reference_case_hints: Use LOS predicate-first getter/inspection style from annotated_C/src/link/LOS_ListEmpty.c and the migrated Xizi first/tail contracts, while preserving the distinction between sentinel heads and data nodes.
